definitions.gloss: shoe cabinet, shoe rack, shoe cupboard
definitions.explanation: A cabinet or storage area at the entrance of a home, school, or building for storing shoes when entering. Named after geta (traditional wooden sandals) but used for all footwear.

examples.japanese: ⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{下駄箱|げたばこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please put your shoes in the shoe cabinet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{下駄箱|げたばこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}っていた→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: There was a letter in my shoe locker at school.

examples.japanese: ⟦{玄関|げんかん}→玄関：05003_genkan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{下駄箱|げたばこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}いた→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: I put a new shoe cabinet in the entryway.

examples.japanese: {下駄箱|げたばこ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦いっぱい→一杯：01793_ippai⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The shoe cabinet is full of shoes.

notes:
COMPOSITION: ⟦{下駄|げた}→下駄：03984_geta⟧ (geta, traditional wooden sandals) + ⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧ (box)

NAME ORIGIN: Although named after traditional geta sandals, modern {下駄箱|げたばこ} are used for all types of footwear including sneakers, boots, and regular shoes.

USAGE:
- At home: Usually located in the ⟦{玄関|げんかん}→玄関：05003_genkan⟧ (entryway)
- At school: Students have individual shoe lockers to change from outdoor to indoor shoes
- At gyms/offices: Used to store street shoes when changing to indoor footwear

ALTERNATIVE NAMES:
- ⟦{靴箱|くつばこ}→靴箱：09735_kutsubako⟧ - shoe box (also used)
- ⟦シューズボックス→シューズボックス：noentry⟧ - shoes box (loanword)
- ⟦シューズロッカー→シューズロッカー：noentry⟧ - shoe locker (in schools)

CULTURAL NOTE: In Japanese schools, students often leave personal notes, love letters, or chocolates (on Valentine's Day) in classmates' shoe lockers.
